entries.german: giebt dem Ulrich v. Rosenberg die Burg Klingenberg, sowie die Klöster Mühlhausen u. Goldenkron zu lebenslänglichem Besitz, nach dessen Tode aber dessen männlichen Erben zu Pfande. Ad m. d. i. Caspar Slyk miles canc.
entries.english: Grants Ulrich von Rosenberg the castle of Klingenberg and the monasteries of Mühlhausen and Goldenkron as a pledge for his lifetime, and after his death to his male heirs. By the mandate of the emperor: Caspar Slyk, miles, chancellor.
